specification_points.description: Decompose a problem into smaller sub-problems
Apply abstraction to identify relevant features and ignore irrelevant detail
Construct structure diagrams, flowcharts, and pseudocode to represent algorithms
Implement and analyse linear search and binary search
Implement and analyse bubble sort and merge sort
Trace recursive algorithms; write recursive solutions for standard problems
Express time complexity using Big-O notation: O(1), O(log n), O(n), O(n log n), O(n²)
Use 1D and 2D arrays; traverse, search, and update elements
Describe and implement singly-linked and doubly-linked lists: insertion, deletion, traversal
Compare arrays and linked lists for different use cases
Describe and implement a stack using an array; implement push, pop, peek, isEmpty
Describe and implement a queue (linear and circular) using an array
Apply stacks to: function call management, expression evaluation (postfix), undo operations
Apply queues to: scheduling, I/O buffering, breadth-first search
Describe the structure of binary trees; implement insertion and search
Perform and implement pre-order, in-order, and post-order tree traversal
Describe hash tables: hash functions, collision resolution (chaining, open addressing)
Analyse worst-case and average-case performance of hash table operations
Use variables, constants, data types, assignment, arithmetic and Boolean expressions
Use sequence, selection (IF, CASE/SWITCH), and iteration (FOR, WHILE, REPEAT-UNTIL)
Define and call procedures and functions; understand parameter passing (by value and reference)
Understand scope: local vs global variables
Open, read, write, and close text files in programs
Handle runtime errors using exception handling constructs (try/except)
